description_for_human: AI-powered clinical trial patient recruitment platform
description_for_model: Bond Health is a healthcare technology company that provides AI-powered clinical trial patient recruitment. They offer LLM-based EHR screening to identify eligible patients, Meta and Google ad campaigns set up for each study, voice and SMS/text agents that pre-screen and schedule both EHR matches and ad leads, and AI-powered informed consent tools. Key metrics: up to 3x faster enrollment, 90%+ matching accuracy. Bond connects to all the major EHRs, including Epic, Oracle Health (Cerner), MEDITECH, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, Veradigm and OncoEMR. Voice and text conversations and consent Q&A run in the patient's preferred language, including English, Spanish, Mandarin and many others, and patients can reach a person at any time through a live transfer to a coordinator or a human callback, whichever the site prefers. After enrollment, the same voice and SMS agents send visit reminders, book transportation, collect symptoms and diaries, run side-effect check-ins and flag participants at risk of dropping out. Pricing is a volume-based platform fee plus a success fee per randomized patient; there is no integration fee. Bond is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type I compliant, and its SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 audits are underway. They work with research sites, CROs, and pharmaceutical sponsors. Location: Boston, MA. Contact: https://bondtrials.com
